instrument_repair.what: deterministic interruptible WORK budget on every PEW-consuming producer; BUDGET_EXHAUSTED outcome with provenance; M's wall-clock fallback removed; tests in archaeon/tests/test_work_budget.py

question: Can the STATE of the evidence (target-free) tell us HOW fossils should be consumed: is there a pre-target coordinate that predicts where the one-step producer G is myopic against a deeper policy, and does routing on it recover the deeper policy's advantage?
loops: LOOP 2 proposes (producers receive fossils only); LOOP 4 (this harness) holds the target, answers exact scores, and enumerates the census; LOOP 3 fixed this file; LOOP 1 never steered. The hidden target never crosses into world construction, producer selection or routing: worlds are STATES, targets are enumerated from the state afterwards.

myopia_definition.decision_state: for an evidence state s and a producer's chosen probe g: delta(s, g) = Q*(s, g) - V*(s), where V*(s) is the exact minimum expected number of further probes to identify the target (adaptive DP over reachable feasible subsets, every probe in {0,1}^L, uniform prior over the feasible set) and Q*(s, g) the same quantity when g is probed first and the continuation is optimal. s is MYOPIC for g iff delta > 0 (tolerance 1e-9). Target-free.
myopia_definition.world: for a state s with feasible census T(s): E_A = mean over t in T(s) of the number of probes arm A needs to identify t (censored at B+1). The deeper policy's advantage is (E_G - E_O)/E_G.
myopia_definition.derivation: from first principles and exact toy computation (scratch s5_explore/s5_state_detail/s5_effect/s5_opt/s5_trace, journal 2026-09-12 S5 section) BEFORE any producer batch: strict two-step count myopia exists (minimal case L 8, two count-known blocks 4/4 with 1 and 2 ones) but is tiny and the two-step count policy is itself myopic at horizon 3; the dominant full-horizon mechanism is that the one-step objective ER = sum n_d^2 / N is a collision statistic that is INDIFFERENT between partitions whose identification futures differ (e.g. {3,3} vs {1,4,1} at N 6, both ER 3.0), and the lexicographic tie-break then picks the entropy-poorer member.

primary.name: kappa_H
primary.definition: at decision state s with the producer's chosen probe g: kappa_H = 1 iff there exists a probe q in {0,1}^L with ER(q) <= ER(g) and H(q) > H(g) (outcome entropy under the uniform prior), i.e. g is dominated in the (count, entropy) order. Computed from the fossils and the probe alphabet only (archaeon/docs/h0h5/S5_RUNNER_2026-09-13.py::coordinates_at); cheap: one pass over the one-step partitions the producer already computes.
primary.prediction: kappa_H = 1 predicts delta(s, g) > 0 for G's own choice; kappa_H = 0 predicts delta = 0. Routing O only where kappa_H fires (arm RH) should recover a material part of O's advantage over G at a minority of O calls.

secondary_reported.kappa_tie: the exact one-step ER-optimal class contains >= 2 distinct partition multisets (state-only)
secondary_reported.kappa_proxy: exactly two unresolved blocks, both of size >= 3 (the product structure where strict two-step myopia was first found)
secondary_reported.pool_suboptimal: G's pool-restricted choice has ER above the exact one-step minimum
secondary_reported.root_coordinates: entropy_disagreement, entropy_deficit_bits, two_block_proxy, two_step_gap (archaeon/producer/s5_coordinates.py) recorded per world at the root

coordinates.leakage_audit: no coordinate takes a target, an outcome, a winner or a future score; signatures asserted in archaeon/tests/test_s5_producers.py; the runner computes coordinates from (fossils, chosen probe) before the score is revealed and the decision-state rows carry the snapshot id of the evidence they were computed from.

families.shell: one fossil 0^L with m in 1..L-1 mismatches
families.prod2: fossils 0^L and 1^a 0^(L-a) with mismatch counts giving block counts uA in 0..a, uB in 0..L-a (every parameter combination)

worlds.dedupe: states with identical feasible sets are one state
worlds.census: every feasible target of every state is run (1828 targets at L 8, 1458 at L 9); expectations are exact under the uniform prior; no target seeds exist
worlds.held_out: L 9 was never examined with any producer or exact policy before this file; L 8 is the derivation set: four reference states were examined with the real producers (counterexample 4/4 blocks 1,2 ones; shell m 2; shell m 2 inside 7; prod 2,2) and two of them traced; the exact greedy-lex vs optimum screen over L 8 states was read (39 of the first 80 states >= 2 %, mean 3.4 %, max 25 %) to set the bar; an instrument smoke run (--quick: the first 6 L 8 states -- shells m 1,2,6,7 and prod2 a1 b7 uB 1,2 -- 100 targets, all arms) was executed and read before this commit to check the runner end to end; its rows are discarded and the same states are rerun in the batch; no rule or bar was changed after seeing it
worlds.selection: no state is chosen or dropped because of any producer's result

arms.U: S4 unchanged, PEW_BLIND, seeded by seed_inputs (lane, L, state_id, target_index, arm, step)
arms.W: S4 unchanged (exhaustive one-step optimum at L <= 12, lexicographic tie-break)
arms.M: S4 unchanged except the phase-0 budget contract (no wall-clock fallback)
arms.GH: NEW, minimal cheap consumer of the mechanism: G's pool and objective, ties on the exact ER numerator broken by larger outcome entropy, then lexicographic (archaeon/producer/s5_producers.py)
arms.O: NEW, deeper reference: exact full-horizon identification policy (DP), memoised across calls per declared semantics, work-budgeted
arms.RH: NEW, routed: G's proposal unless kappa_H fires for it, then O's proposal (O called only there)
arms.evidence_isolation: each arm holds its own fossil list per target; nothing returned to one arm is visible to another

budget.censoring: identified_at = B + 1 when not identified within B

compute_bounds.note: O_max_targets exceeds max_feasible_targets so SCOPE_EXCEEDED cannot trip by construction; any BUDGET_EXHAUSTED on O is an instrument failure by the rule

decision_state_audit.what: for every decision state G visits (depth <= 6), record V*, Q*(s, G's probe), delta, myopic_exact and the coordinates; precision/recall of each coordinate for myopic_exact

primary_metric.name: exact expected probes to identification per state
primary_metric.pairing: per target within a state (same target, same initial state)
primary_metric.separated_at_bar: rel advantage over G >= 0.02 AND the arm wins more targets than G within the state

list: nAUC_0 over the first 3 probes normalised by log2 N

per-step log2|T|, gain, fixed bits, task score, distance/entropy/ER of the probe, redundancy flag, compute seconds, work units, budget/scope outcomes, tie-class size, snapshot id, producer version, route flags

verdict_rule.INSTRUMENT_FAILURE: O returns BUDGET_EXHAUSTED or SCOPE_EXCEEDED on any proposal; or the exact optimum O is worse than G at the bar in any state; or blind U beats G at the bar in any state
verdict_rule.NO_SEPARATION: O is separated from G at the bar in fewer than 1/3 of states AND O's mean relative advantage over G is below 0.02: G is not materially myopic even against the exact optimum on worlds built to expose myopia
verdict_rule.PLURALITY_SUPPORTED: O separates (>= 1/3 of states at the bar, or mean relative advantage >= 0.02) AND kappa_H routes: precision >= 0.5 and recall >= 0.5 on G's decision states AND RH is separated from G at the bar in >= 1/3 of states with O called on <= 1/2 of its proposals
verdict_rule.DIFFERENCE_WITHOUT_ROUTABILITY: O separates but kappa_H does not route under the conditions above
verdict_rule.note: GH, W, M are reported against G with the same bar; they do not enter the verdict. Sub-bar drift routes nothing. The verdict is computed by S5_RUNNER::evaluate exactly as written here; L 8 and L 9 are pooled for the verdict and reported separately.

stopping_rule: every eligible state once, every target once, no reruns, no seed or state selection after the fact
assumptions: uniform prior over the feasible set for every expectation (named, as in S3/S4)
producers frozen at the PRODUCER_VERSION recorded on every proposal
